name: カレンダー接続の説明と会議の予定を並べる管理ウィジェット
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Notion calendar-connection and upcoming-events card shown in the primary original screenshot crop. Match the source crop's wide 964:339 aspect ratio (about 2.84:1), use the complete rounded card with its thin light-gray border, and keep the card edge to edge with no outside page area or extra section heading. The Japanese mock is secondary and supplies translated copy; the original screenshot controls geometry, component boundaries, icon detail, event-row alignment, divider, muted colors and CTA color.

Preserve the source's two equal-width columns and fine vertical divider at the center. In the left column, place the small original stacked-calendar/page icon near the upper-left inset; below it place the Japanese heading 「会議メモとカレンダーの予定を接続」, then two short lines 「会議へ参加し、記録して要約します。」 and 「会議の情報を一つの場所へまとめます。」, followed by the blue text action 「カレンダーを接続」 near the lower-left. Keep the source's generous vertical breathing room and restrained sizes.

In the right column, show exactly two faint, muted upcoming-event entries. Each entry has a narrow date column on the left, a slim pale vertical rule, then title and time/location on the right. Entry one: date 「今日」 / 「7月9日」; title 「チームの朝会」; metadata 「9時 · 事務所」; beneath it a tiny video-camera icon and 「参加してメモを取る」. Entry two: date 「木曜日」 / 「7月10日」; title 「案件の確認」; metadata 「10時 · 事務所」. Keep the two rows vertically spaced as in the original.

Use white background, very light neutral-gray border and source-like muted gray text for the explanatory card and event examples. The action link is blue, following the original screenshot rather than the mock's green. Keep the icon and event text low-contrast like the original capture. Render all text cleanly and exactly as supplied. Do not add calendar connection success, a real account state, additional events, buttons, logos, headings, or data.
reviewNotes: v001 geometry and Japanese content match the source, but text/icon contrast and weight are too strong and the blue link is too vivid versus the original pale screenshot; preserve as pending visual correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
